name: Translate French Speech to English Audio
description: Generate French speech from text, transcribe it, translate the transcript into English and generate English speech in the same voice.
requirements: Use only text and generated audio that can be public: Open Flow stores both audio files as public-read download URLs accessible to anyone with the URL; automatic expiry is not verified
ElevenLabs connection with a French/English-capable voice and multilingual_v2 API allowance; Connector file transit must be enabled
OpenAI connection with Whisper transcription access; whisper-1 shuts down February26,2027
Configured gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 translator or compatible replacement before January14,2027
n8n Header Auth xi-api-key credentials on both ElevenLabs HTTP nodes and OpenAI credentials for transcription/model
French text and an ElevenLabs voice ID; speech text limit10000characters per step, ASR file limit25MB
